put('src/pantry.ts','''export interface Item {
  name: string;
  needed: boolean;
}

export interface Persistence {
  load(): Item[];
  save(items: readonly Item[]): void;
}

export class Pantry {
  private items: Item[] = [];
  private saveBlocked = false;
  unsaved = false;
  warning = \"\";

  constructor(private readonly persistence: Persistence) {
    try {
      this.items = persistence.load();
    } catch {
      this.saveBlocked = true;
      this.unsaved = true;
      this.warning = \"Saved list could not be read. Changes are unsaved; retry saving only when ready to replace it.\";
    }
  }

  list(): Item[] {
    return this.items.map((item) => ({ ...item }));
  }

  shoppingList(): Item[] {
    return this.list().filter((item) => item.needed);
  }

  add(suppliedName: string): void {
    const name = suppliedName.trim();
    if ("'!name) throw new Error("Enter an item name.");
    if (this.items.some((item) => item.name.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase())) return;
    this.items.push({ name, needed: false });
    this.persist();
  }

  setNeeded(name: string, needed: boolean): void {
    const item = this.items.find((item) => item.name === name);
    if (!item) throw new Error("Item was not found.");
    item.needed = needed;
    this.persist();
  }

  retrySave(): void {
    this.saveBlocked = false;
    this.persist();
  }

  private persist(): void {
    this.unsaved = true;
    if (this.saveBlocked) return;
    try {
      this.persistence.save(this.list());
      this.unsaved = false;
      this.warning = "";
    } catch {
      this.warning = "Changes are unsaved. Keep using this session and retry saving before reloading.";
    }
  }
}
'"''')

export function mount(root: HTMLElement, pantry: Pantry): void {
  let view = \"pantry\";
  root.innerHTML = "'`<h1>Pantry list</h1>
    <p>Keep track of supplies and what you need to buy.</p>
    <form><label for="item-name">Item name</label>
      <input id="item-name" name="name" autocomplete="off" required />
      <button type="submit">Add item</button></form>
    <p id="input-error" role="alert"></p>
    <nav aria-label="Lists"><button id="pantry-view">Pantry</button>
      <button id="shopping-view">Shopping list</button></nav>
    <h2 id="view-title"></h2><ul id="items"></ul>
    <p id="save-status" role="status"></p><button id="retry-save">Retry saving</button>`;
  const form = root.querySelector<HTMLFormElement>("form")!;
  const input = root.querySelector<HTMLInputElement>("#item-name")!;
  const error = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#input-error")!;
  const items = root.querySelector<HTMLUListElement>("#items")!;
  const status = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#save-status")!;
  const retry = root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#retry-save")!;
  function render(): void {
    root.querySelector<HTMLElement>("#view-title")!.textContent = view === "pantry" ? "Pantry" : "Shopping list";
    root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#pantry-view")!.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(view === "pantry"));
    root.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>("#shopping-view")!.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(view === "shopping"));
    items.replaceChildren();
    const list = view === "pantry" ? pantry.list() : pantry.shoppingList();
    if (list.length === 0) {
      const empty = document.createElement("li");
      empty.textContent = view === "pantry" ? "No items yet." : "Nothing marked needed.";
      items.append(empty);
    }
    for (const item of list) {
      const row = document.createElement("li");
      const label = document.createElement("label");
      const checkbox = document.createElement("input");
      checkbox.type = "checkbox";
      checkbox.checked = item.needed;
      checkbox.setAttribute("aria-label", `Need ${item.name}`);
      checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => { pantry.setNeeded(item.name, checkbox.checked); render(); });
      label.append(checkbox, document.createTextNode(` ${item.name}`));
      row.append(label);
      items.append(row);
    }
    status.textContent = pantry.unsaved ? pantry.warning : "Saved locally.";
    retry.hidden = !pantry.unsaved;
  }
  form.addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    try { pantry.add(input.value); input.value = ""; error.textContent = ""; render(); }
    catch (cause) { error.textContent = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Could not add item."; }
  });
  root.querySelector("#pantry-view")!.addEventListener("click", () => { view = "pantry"; render(); });
  root.querySelector("#shopping-view")!.addEventListener("click", () => { view = "shopping"; render(); });
  retry.addEventListener("click", () => { pantry.retrySave(); render(); });
  render();
}
'"''')
